title: Neutral client shell contract
prompt: Establish a minimal production client shell from the approved screen-flow direction. Do not migrate hardcoded game logic from ui-prototype and do not add Firebase or assets. Keep the work narrowly focused on an accessible renderable shell and its tests.
acceptance: The client renders a named, accessible neutral app shell.
A render smoke test covers the shell's primary landmark.
The package lint, typecheck, test and build scripts pass.
